ko.title: 체중 감량 약물의 가격 하락: GLP-1 가격 인하가 환자, 고용주, 보험사에 의미하는 바

segments.src: For several years, GLP-1 medicines such as semaglutide and tirzepatide have been among the most talked-about and hardest-to-afford drugs in American health care.
segments.tr: 지난 몇 년 동안 세마글루티드와 티르제파티드 같은 GLP-1 의약품은 미국 의료계에서 가장 많이 회자되면서도 가장 비용 부담이 큰 약물 중 하나였습니다.

segments.src: List prices of roughly $1,000 or more per month put them out of reach for many people, and coverage rules often made access harder still.
segments.tr: 월 약 1,000달러 이상에 달하는 정가로 인해 많은 사람들이 이용하기 어려웠으며, 보장 규칙으로 인해 접근성이 더욱 제한되는 경우가 많았습니다.

segments.src: That picture is now shifting.
segments.tr: 이제 이러한 상황이 바뀌고 있습니다.

segments.src: Lower prices, new oral options and direct-to-consumer sales are widening the pool of people who can realistically afford treatment, and they are forcing employers, Medicare and private insurers to rethink what they cover.
segments.tr: 더 낮은 가격, 새로운 경구용 옵션, 그리고 소비자 직접 판매 방식은 실제로 치료를 감당할 수 있는 사람들의 풀을 넓히고 있으며, 고용주, 메디케어, 민간 보험사가 보장 범위를 재고하도록 강제하고 있습니다.

segments.src: This article explains what is changing, who stands to benefit, and why coverage decisions may matter more than any headline price.
segments.tr: 이 글에서는 무엇이 바뀌고 있는지, 누가 혜택을 받을 수 있는지, 그리고 보장 결정이 왜 어떤 표면적 가격보다 더 중요할 수 있는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: It is general information, not medical or financial advice.
segments.tr: 이는 일반적인 정보 제공을 위한 것이며 의료적 또는 재정적 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Prices, programs and eligibility rules change often, so check current details with your insurer, pharmacist or prescriber.
segments.tr: 가격, 프로그램 및 자격 규칙은 자주 변경되므로 보험사, 약사 또는 처방자에게 현재 세부 정보를 확인하십시오.

segments.src: ## Why prices are moving
segments.tr: ## 가격이 움직이는 이유

segments.src: Several forces are pushing costs down at the same time:
segments.tr: 여러 요인들이 동시에 비용을 낮추고 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Lower list and cash prices.** Manufacturers have introduced reduced self-pay prices and negotiated pricing arrangements, especially for lower starting doses.
segments.tr: - **더 낮은 정가 및 현금 가격.** 제조업체들은 특히 낮은 초기 복용량을 중심으로 인하된 본인 부담 가격과 협상된 가격 책정 방식을 도입했습니다.

segments.src: - **Direct-to-consumer channels.** Drugmakers now sell directly to patients through their own online platforms and telehealth partners, bypassing some of the usual pharmacy and middleman layers. Cash prices are often lower than the old list price, though they still vary by dose.
segments.tr: - **소비자 직접 판매 채널.** 제약사들은 이제 일반적인 약국 및 중간 유통 단계를 우회하여 자체 온라인 플랫폼과 원격 의료 파트너를 통해 환자에게 직접 판매합니다. 현금 가격은 여전히 복용량에 따라 다르지만 종종 이전 정가보다 낮습니다.

segments.src: - **Pill formulations.** Oral GLP-1 products avoid the cost and complexity of injectable pens, and they may be easier to manufacture and distribute at scale. More oral candidates are in the pipeline.
segments.tr: - **알약 제형.** 경구용 GLP-1 제품은 주사형 펜의 비용과 복잡성을 피할 수 있으며, 대규모 제조 및 유통이 더 쉬울 수 있습니다. 더 많은 경구용 후보 물질이 파이프라인에 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Competition.** With multiple companies selling similar drugs, and more expected, pricing pressure is increasing. Supply shortages that once limited access have also eased.
segments.tr: - **경쟁.** 유사한 약물을 판매하는 여러 기업이 있고 더 많은 기업이 예상됨에 따라 가격 경쟁 압박이 증가하고 있습니다. 한때 접근성을 제한했던 공급 부족 현상도 완화되었습니다.

segments.src: - **Government negotiation and policy.** Federal pricing agreements and Medicare negotiation efforts have put GLP-1 costs in the political spotlight.
segments.tr: - **정부 협상 및 정책.** 연방 가격 책정 협정과 메디케어 협상 노력으로 인해 GLP-1 비용이 정치적 스포트라이트를 받고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What it means for patients
segments.tr: ## 환자에게 의미하는 바

segments.src: For people paying out of pocket, lower cash prices can turn a drug that was out of reach into one that is difficult but possible.
segments.tr: 본인 부담으로 비용을 지불하는 사람들에게는 더 낮은 현금 가격이 손에 닿지 않던 약물을 어렵지만 가능한 약물로 바꿀 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A few practical points apply:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 실용적인 사항이 적용됩니다:

segments.src: 1. **Compare the full cost.** Look at the monthly price at your actual dose, not only an introductory rate. Maintenance doses may cost more than starter doses.
segments.tr: 1. **전체 비용을 비교하십시오.** 소개 요금뿐만 아니라 실제 복용량에서의 월 가격을 살펴보십시오. 유지 용량은 시작 용량보다 비용이 더 많이 들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Ask about coverage first.** Insurance may still be cheaper than cash, and some plans cover the drugs for diabetes but not for weight loss alone.
segments.tr: 2. **보장에 대해 먼저 문의하십시오.** 보험이 현금보다 여전히 저렴할 수 있으며, 일부 플랜은 당뇨병에 대해서는 약물을 보장하지만 체중 감량 단독 목적에 대해서는 보장하지 않습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Treat it as long-term.** Clinical evidence suggests that many people regain weight after stopping these medicines. A price that works for three months may not work for three years.
segments.tr: 3. **장기적인 관점으로 다루십시오.** 임상 증거에 따르면 많은 사람들이 이러한 약물 복용을 중단한 후에 체중이 다시 증가합니다. 3개월 동안 효과가 있는 가격이 3년 동안 효과가 없을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Stay with licensed care.** Buy only from licensed pharmacies and manufacturers' authorized channels. Be wary of unregulated "research" products or suspiciously cheap online offers, and speak with a clinician about side effects, suitability and monitoring.
segments.tr: 4. **허가된 치료를 유지하십시오.** 면허가 있는 약국과 제조업체의 공인된 채널에서만 구입하십시오. 규제되지 않는 "연구용" 제품이나 의심스러울 정도로 저렴한 온라인 제안에 주의하고, 부작용, 적합성 및 모니터링에 대해 임상 의사와 상담하십시오.

segments.src: 5. **Don't skip the basics.** The drugs are generally prescribed alongside nutrition and activity changes, and results differ from person to person.
segments.tr: 5. **기본 사항을 건너뛰지 마십시오.** 약물은 일반적으로 영양 및 활동 변화와 함께 처방되며, 결과는 사람마다 다릅니다.

segments.src: ## What it means for employers
segments.tr: ## 고용주에게 의미하는 바

segments.src: Employers that fund their own health plans have been among the most cautious payers.
segments.tr: 자체 건강 보험을 자금 지원하는 고용주는 가장 신중한 지불자 중 하나였습니다.

segments.src: Their concern is not just the price per prescription but the number of employees who could qualify.
segments.tr: 그들의 관심사는 처방전당 가격뿐만 아니라 자격을 갖춘 임직원의 수입니다.

segments.src: If a large share of eligible workers started treatment at a high price, the cost could overwhelm a benefits budget.
segments.tr: 적격 근로자의 상당수가 높은 가격으로 치료를 시작하면 비용이 복리후생 예산을 압도할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Lower prices change that math, but they do not remove the tension.
segments.tr: 낮은 가격은 그 계산을 바꾸지만 긴장감을 없애지는 못합니다.

segments.src: Employers are weighing:
segments.tr: 고용주들은 다음을 저울질하고 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Coverage limits.** Some require prior authorization, a documented body mass index threshold, or participation in a lifestyle program.
segments.tr: - **보장 한도.** 일부는 사전 승인, 문서화된 체질량 지수 임계값, 또는 라이프스타일 프로그램 참여를 요구합니다.

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing design.** Higher copays can limit spending but may discourage people who would benefit most.
segments.tr: - **비용 분담 설계.** 더 높은 본인부담금은 지출을 제한할 수 있지만 가장 큰 혜택을 받을 사람들을 낙담시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Possible offsetting savings.** Better control of weight, diabetes and heart-related risks could reduce other medical spending over time, but the timing and size of those savings remain debated. Many employees change jobs before long-term savings show up for a given employer.
segments.tr: - **가능한 상쇄 절감 효과.** 체중, 당뇨병 및 심장 관련 위험의 더 나은 관리는 시간이 지남에 따라 다른 의료 지출을 줄일 수 있지만, 그러한 절감의 시기와 규모는 여전히 논쟁 중입니다. 많은 직원들이 특정 고용주에게 장기적인 절감 효과가 나타나기 전에 직장을 바꿉니다.

segments.src: - **Alternatives to traditional coverage.** Some employers are exploring negotiated direct purchasing arrangements or navigation services rather than adding the drugs to standard drug benefits.
segments.tr: - **기존 보장의 대안.** 일부 고용주는 표준 약물 혜택에 약물을 추가하는 대신 협상된 직접 구매 계약 또는 내비게이션 서비스를 모색하고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What it means for Medicare and Medicaid
segments.tr: ## 메디케어와 메디케이드에 의미하는 바

segments.src: Public programs have historically been limited by law and by cost.
segments.tr: 공공 프로그램은 역사적으로 법률과 비용에 의해 제한되어 왔습니다.

segments.src: Medicare Part D has generally covered these drugs for conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular risk reduction in certain patients, and some other approved uses, but has not broadly covered medications used only for weight loss.
segments.tr: 메디케어 파트 D는 일반적으로 당뇨병, 특정 환자의 심혈관 위험 감소, 그리고 기타 일부 승인된 용도와 같은 질환에 대해 이러한 약물을 보장해 왔지만, 체중 감량에만 사용되는 약물은 광범위하게 보장하지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Federal and state officials have been exploring pilots, price agreements and rule changes that could expand access for some beneficiaries, and state Medicaid programs have taken differing approaches, with some adding coverage and others pulling back because of budget pressure.
segments.tr: 연방 및 주 관료들은 일부 수혜자에 대한 접근성을 확대할 수 있는 파일럿, 가격 협정 및 규칙 변경을 모색해 왔으며, 주 메디케이드 프로그램은 예산 압박으로 인해 일부는 보장을 추가하고 다른 일부는 철회하는 등 서로 다른 접근 방식을 취했습니다.

segments.src: The key question is scale.
segments.tr: 핵심 질문은 규모입니다.

segments.src: Millions of Medicare beneficiaries have obesity, so even a moderate net price per person can add up to a very large program cost.
segments.tr: 수백만 명의 메디케어 수혜자가 비만을 앓고 있으므로 1인당 순가격이 적당하더라도 매우 큰 프로그램 비용으로 합산될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Policymakers are balancing potential health benefits against the effect on federal spending and Part D premiums.
segments.tr: 정책 입안자들은 잠재적 건강 혜택과 연방 지출 및 파트 D 보험료에 미치는 영향을 저울질하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Details of any expansion, including eligibility criteria, copays and start dates, should be confirmed through official Medicare and state sources.
segments.tr: 자격 기준, 본인부담금 및 시작일을 포함한 모든 확장의 세부 사항은 공식 메디케어 및 주 출처를 통해 확인해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## What it means for insurers
segments.tr: ## 보험사에 의미하는 바

segments.src: Insurers face a difficult trade-off.
segments.tr: 보험사는 어려운 상충 관계에 직면해 있습니다.

segments.src: Covering these drugs broadly can improve health outcomes for members, but it can raise premiums in the short run.
segments.tr: 이러한 약물을 광범위하게 보장하면 가입자의 건강 결과가 향상될 수 있지만 단기적으로 보험료가 인상될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Lower net prices make coverage easier to justify, yet insurers still manage costs through:
segments.tr: 낮은 순가격은 보장을 정당화하기 쉽게 만들지만, 보험사는 여전히 다음과 같은 방식으로 비용을 관리합니다:

segments.src: - Prior authorization and step requirements
segments.tr: - 사전 승인 및 단계별 요구사항

segments.src: - Quantity limits and renewal criteria that require evidence of benefit
segments.tr: - 혜택의 증거를 요구하는 수량 한도 및 갱신 기준

segments.src: - Preferred-drug lists that favor a particular product after negotiated rebates
segments.tr: - 협상된 리베이트 후 특정 제품을 선호하는 선호 약물 목록

segments.src: - Programs that pair medication with coaching or clinical monitoring
segments.tr: - 약물 치료와 코칭 또는 임상 모니터링을 결합하는 프로그램

segments.src: How these tools are used will shape real-world access.
segments.tr: 이러한 도구가 사용되는 방식은 실제 접근성을 형성할 것입니다.

segments.src: Two people with the same prescription can face very different out-of-pocket costs depending on their plan.
segments.tr: 동일한 처방전을 가진 두 사람은 플랜에 따라 매우 다른 본인 부담 비용에 직면할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The bigger picture for the health system
segments.tr: ## 의료 시스템의 더 큰 그림

segments.src: If prices keep falling and more people start treatment, the effects could extend well beyond pharmacy budgets.
segments.tr: 가격이 계속 하락하고 더 많은 사람들이 치료를 시작하면 그 영향은 약국 예산을 훨씬 넘어설 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Possible outcomes include lower rates of diabetes progression, fewer cardiovascular events and reduced joint and sleep-related problems.
segments.tr: 가능한 결과에는 당뇨병 진행률 감소, 심혈관 사건 감소, 관절 및 수면 관련 문제 감소가 포함됩니다.

segments.src: At the same time, the health system could face higher drug spending, demand for clinicians who can manage long-term therapy, and questions about equity if only some groups can obtain coverage.
segments.tr: 동시에 의료 시스템은 더 높은 약물 지출, 장기 치료를 관리할 수 있는 임상 의사에 대한 수요, 그리고 일부 그룹만 보장을 받을 수 있는 경우 공평성에 대한 의문에 직면할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Economists and health plans broadly agree on one point: the net price, after rebates and discounts, matters more than the list price.
segments.tr: 경제학자와 건강 보험사는 한 가지 점에서 광범위하게 동의합니다. 리베이트와 할인 후의 순가격이 정가보다 더 중요하다는 것입니다.

segments.src: A lower sticker price does not automatically mean lower spending for a plan, and it does not automatically mean lower costs for a patient.
segments.tr: 낮은 스티커 가격이 플랜에 대한 낮은 지출을 자동으로 의미하지는 않으며, 환자에 대한 낮은 비용을 자동으로 의미하지도 않습니다.

segments.src: Coverage design, cost sharing and how long people stay on treatment will determine the real financial effect.
segments.tr: 보장 설계, 비용 분담, 그리고 사람들이 치료를 받는 기간이 실제 재정적 영향을 결정할 것입니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 다음에 주목할 점

segments.src: - **New approvals and launches** of oral and next-generation GLP-1 products, and how they are priced.
segments.tr: - **경구용 및 차세대 GLP-1 제품의 새로운 승인 및 출시**, 그리고 가격 책정 방식.

segments.src: - **Medicare and Medicaid policy changes** that could broaden or narrow eligibility.
segments.tr: - **자격을 넓히거나 좁힐 수 있는 메디케어 및 메디케이드 정책 변경**.

segments.src: - **Employer plan decisions** during open enrollment season.
segments.tr: - **공개 등록 시즌 동안의 고용주 플랜 결정**.

segments.src: - **Long-term outcome data** on whether lower prices translate into healthier populations and savings elsewhere in the system.
segments.tr: - **낮은 가격이 더 건강한 인구와 시스템 내 다른 곳의 절감으로 이어지는지에 대한 장기적인 결과 데이터**.

segments.src: - **Safety and quality oversight** of compounded and online-sold products.
segments.tr: - **조제 및 온라인 판매 제품에 대한 안전성 및 품질 감독**.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: GLP-1 drugs are becoming more affordable than they were, but affordability is still uneven.
segments.tr: GLP-1 약물은 예전보다 가격이 저렴해지고 있지만 여전히 경제성은 불균등합니다.

segments.src: For patients, the best steps are to check coverage, compare cash prices at the dose they will actually use, and work with a licensed clinician.

zh.title: 减肥药价格下降：GLP-1价格下跌对患者、雇主和保险公司的意义

segments.src: For several years, GLP-1 medicines such as semaglutide and tirzepatide have been among the most talked-about and hardest-to-afford drugs in American health care.
segments.tr: 多年来，如司美格鲁肽和替尔泊肽等GLP-1药物一直是美国医疗保健中讨论最多且最难以负担的药物。

segments.src: List prices of roughly $1,000 or more per month put them out of reach for many people, and coverage rules often made access harder still.
segments.tr: 每月约1000美元或更高的标价让许多人望尘莫及，而报销规则往往使获取药物更加困难。

segments.src: That picture is now shifting.
segments.tr: 这种局面现在正在发生变化。

segments.src: Lower prices, new oral options and direct-to-consumer sales are widening the pool of people who can realistically afford treatment, and they are forcing employers, Medicare and private insurers to rethink what they cover.
segments.tr: 更低的价格、新的口服选择以及直接面向消费者的销售正在扩大能够实际负担治疗的人群，并迫使雇主、联邦医疗保险（Medicare）和私人保险公司重新思考他们的报销范围。

segments.src: This article explains what is changing, who stands to benefit, and why coverage decisions may matter more than any headline price.
segments.tr: 本文解释了正在发生的变化、谁将从中受益，以及为什么报销决策可能比任何标价都更重要。

segments.src: It is general information, not medical or financial advice.
segments.tr: 这仅是一般信息，并非医疗或财务建议。

segments.src: Prices, programs and eligibility rules change often, so check current details with your insurer, pharmacist or prescriber.
segments.tr: 价格、项目和资格规则经常变化，因此请向您的保险公司、药剂师或处方医生核实当前详情。

segments.src: ## Why prices are moving
segments.tr: ## 为什么价格在变动

segments.src: Several forces are pushing costs down at the same time:
segments.tr: 几股力量同时在推低成本：

segments.src: - **Lower list and cash prices.** Manufacturers have introduced reduced self-pay prices and negotiated pricing arrangements, especially for lower starting doses.
segments.tr: - **更低的标价和现金价。** 制造商推出了降低的自付价格和谈判定价安排，特别是针对较低的起始剂量。

segments.src: - **Direct-to-consumer channels.** Drugmakers now sell directly to patients through their own online platforms and telehealth partners, bypassing some of the usual pharmacy and middleman layers. Cash prices are often lower than the old list price, though they still vary by dose.
segments.tr: - **直接面向消费者的渠道。** 药企现在通过自己的在线平台和远程医疗合作伙伴直接向患者销售，绕过了部分常规的药房和中间商环节。现金价格通常比旧标价低，尽管它们仍随剂量而异。

segments.src: - **Pill formulations.** Oral GLP-1 products avoid the cost and complexity of injectable pens, and they may be easier to manufacture and distribute at scale. More oral candidates are in the pipeline.
segments.tr: - **药丸剂型。** 口服GLP-1产品避免了注射笔的成本和复杂性，并且它们可能更容易大规模制造和分销。更多的口服候选药物正在研发中。

segments.src: - **Competition.** With multiple companies selling similar drugs, and more expected, pricing pressure is increasing. Supply shortages that once limited access have also eased.
segments.tr: - **竞争。** 随着多家公司销售相似的药物，且预计会有更多公司加入，定价压力正在增加。一度限制获取的供应短缺问题也已缓解。

segments.src: - **Government negotiation and policy.** Federal pricing agreements and Medicare negotiation efforts have put GLP-1 costs in the political spotlight.
segments.tr: - **政府谈判与政策。** 联邦定价协议和Medicare谈判努力将GLP-1成本推到了政治聚光灯下。

segments.src: ## What it means for patients
segments.tr: ## 这对患者意味着什么

segments.src: For people paying out of pocket, lower cash prices can turn a drug that was out of reach into one that is difficult but possible.
segments.tr: 对于自付费用的人来说，更低的现金价格可以将一种高不可攀的药物变成一种虽然困难但有可能负担得起的药物。

segments.src: A few practical points apply:
segments.tr: 有几个实用要点适用：

segments.src: 1. **Compare the full cost.** Look at the monthly price at your actual dose, not only an introductory rate. Maintenance doses may cost more than starter doses.
segments.tr: 1. **比较总成本。** 查看您实际使用剂量时的每月价格，而不仅仅是介绍性价格。维持剂量可能比起始剂量花费更多。

segments.src: 2. **Ask about coverage first.** Insurance may still be cheaper than cash, and some plans cover the drugs for diabetes but not for weight loss alone.
segments.tr: 2. **首先询问报销情况。** 保险可能仍然比现金便宜，并且一些计划涵盖用于糖尿病的药物，但不涵盖仅用于减肥的药物。

segments.src: 3. **Treat it as long-term.** Clinical evidence suggests that many people regain weight after stopping these medicines. A price that works for three months may not work for three years.
segments.tr: 3. **将其视为长期治疗。** 临床证据表明，许多人在停用这些药物后会重新发胖。三个月适用的价格可能不适合三年。

segments.src: 4. **Stay with licensed care.** Buy only from licensed pharmacies and manufacturers' authorized channels. Be wary of unregulated "research" products or suspiciously cheap online offers, and speak with a clinician about side effects, suitability and monitoring.
segments.tr: 4. **坚持持牌护理。** 仅从持牌药房和制造商授权渠道购买。警惕不受监管的“研究”产品或可疑便宜的网上优惠，并与临床医生讨论副作用、适宜性和监测。

segments.src: 5. **Don't skip the basics.** The drugs are generally prescribed alongside nutrition and activity changes, and results differ from person to person.
segments.tr: 5. **不要跳过基础。** 这些药物通常与营养和活动改变一起开处方，结果因人而异。

segments.src: ## What it means for employers
segments.tr: ## 这对雇主意味着什么

segments.src: Employers that fund their own health plans have been among the most cautious payers.
segments.tr: 资助自己健康计划的雇主一直是最大胆谨慎的支付方。

segments.src: Their concern is not just the price per prescription but the number of employees who could qualify.
segments.tr: 他们关心的不仅是每张处方的价格，还有可能符合条件的员工数量。

segments.src: If a large share of eligible workers started treatment at a high price, the cost could overwhelm a benefits budget.
segments.tr: 如果大量符合条件的员工以高价开始治疗，这笔成本可能会压垮福利预算。

segments.src: Lower prices change that math, but they do not remove the tension.
segments.tr: 更低的价格改变了这种计算，但并没有消除紧张关系。

segments.src: Employers are weighing:
segments.tr: 雇主正在权衡：

segments.src: - **Coverage limits.** Some require prior authorization, a documented body mass index threshold, or participation in a lifestyle program.
segments.tr: - **报销限制。** 一些雇主需要事先授权、有记录的身体质量指数（BMI）门槛，或参与生活方式项目。

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing design.** Higher copays can limit spending but may discourage people who would benefit most.
segments.tr: - **分摊费用设计。** 更高的自付额可以限制支出，但也可能阻碍最能受益的人。

segments.src: - **Possible offsetting savings.** Better control of weight, diabetes and heart-related risks could reduce other medical spending over time, but the timing and size of those savings remain debated. Many employees change jobs before long-term savings show up for a given employer.
segments.tr: - **可能抵消的节省。** 更好地控制体重、糖尿病和心脏相关风险随着时间的推移可以减少其他医疗支出，但这些节省的时间和规模仍存在争议。许多员工在长期节省对特定雇主显现之前就换了工作。

segments.src: - **Alternatives to traditional coverage.** Some employers are exploring negotiated direct purchasing arrangements or navigation services rather than adding the drugs to standard drug benefits.
segments.tr: - **传统报销的替代方案。** 一些雇主正在探索谈判直接采购安排或导航服务，而不是将药物添加到标准药物福利中。

segments.src: ## What it means for Medicare and Medicaid
segments.tr: ## 这对Medicare和Medicaid意味着什么

segments.src: Public programs have historically been limited by law and by cost.
segments.tr: 公共项目历史上一直受到法律和成本的限制。

segments.src: Medicare Part D has generally covered these drugs for conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular risk reduction in certain patients, and some other approved uses, but has not broadly covered medications used only for weight loss.
segments.tr: Medicare D部分通常涵盖针对糖尿病、某些患者的心血管风险降低以及其他一些批准用途的这些药物，但并未广泛涵盖仅用于减肥的药物。

segments.src: Federal and state officials have been exploring pilots, price agreements and rule changes that could expand access for some beneficiaries, and state Medicaid programs have taken differing approaches, with some adding coverage and others pulling back because of budget pressure.
segments.tr: 联邦和州官员一直在探索可以为某些受益人扩大获取途径的试点、价格协议和规则变更，各州的Medicaid项目采取了不同的方法，一些增加了报销，另一些则由于预算压力而缩减。

segments.src: The key question is scale.
segments.tr: 关键问题是规模。

segments.src: Millions of Medicare beneficiaries have obesity, so even a moderate net price per person can add up to a very large program cost.
segments.tr: 数百万Medicare受益人患有肥胖症，因此即使每人的净价格适中，也会累积成非常巨大的项目成本。

segments.src: Policymakers are balancing potential health benefits against the effect on federal spending and Part D premiums.
segments.tr: 决策者正在平衡潜在的健康益处与对联邦支出和D部分保费的影响。

segments.src: Details of any expansion, including eligibility criteria, copays and start dates, should be confirmed through official Medicare and state sources.
segments.tr: 任何扩大的细节，包括资格标准、自付额和开始日期，都应通过官方Medicare和州来源进行确认。

segments.src: ## What it means for insurers
segments.tr: ## 这对保险公司意味着什么

segments.src: Insurers face a difficult trade-off.
segments.tr: 保险公司面临着艰难的权衡。

segments.src: Covering these drugs broadly can improve health outcomes for members, but it can raise premiums in the short run.
segments.tr: 广泛涵盖这些药物可以改善会员的健康结果，但在短期内会提高保费。

segments.src: Lower net prices make coverage easier to justify, yet insurers still manage costs through:
segments.tr: 较低的净价格使得报销更容易证明其合理性，然而保险公司仍然通过以下方式管理成本：

segments.src: - Prior authorization and step requirements
segments.tr: - 事先授权和步骤要求

segments.src: - Quantity limits and renewal criteria that require evidence of benefit
segments.tr: - 需要疗效证据的数量限制和续签标准

segments.src: - Preferred-drug lists that favor a particular product after negotiated rebates
segments.tr: - 在谈判返利后青睐特定产品的首选药物清单

segments.src: - Programs that pair medication with coaching or clinical monitoring
segments.tr: - 将药物与指导或临床监测相结合的项目

segments.src: How these tools are used will shape real-world access.
segments.tr: 这些工具的使用方式将塑造现实世界的获取途径。

segments.src: Two people with the same prescription can face very different out-of-pocket costs depending on their plan.
segments.tr: 两个拥有相同处方的人可能会根据其计划面临非常不同的自付费用。

segments.src: ## The bigger picture for the health system
segments.tr: ## 医疗系统的大局观

segments.src: If prices keep falling and more people start treatment, the effects could extend well beyond pharmacy budgets.
segments.tr: 如果价格继续下跌且更多人开始治疗，其影响可能会远远超出药房预算。

segments.src: Possible outcomes include lower rates of diabetes progression, fewer cardiovascular events and reduced joint and sleep-related problems.
segments.tr: 可能的结果包括降低糖尿病进展率、减少心血管事件以及减少关节和睡眠相关问题。

segments.src: At the same time, the health system could face higher drug spending, demand for clinicians who can manage long-term therapy, and questions about equity if only some groups can obtain coverage.
segments.tr: 与此同时，医疗系统可能会面临更高的药物支出、对能够管理长期治疗的临床医生的需求，以及如果只有某些群体能够获得报销而产生的公平性问题。

segments.src: Economists and health plans broadly agree on one point: the net price, after rebates and discounts, matters more than the list price.
segments.tr: 经济学家和健康计划在一点上达成广泛共识：在扣除返利和折扣后的净价格，比标价更重要。

segments.src: A lower sticker price does not automatically mean lower spending for a plan, and it does not automatically mean lower costs for a patient.
segments.tr: 较低的贴纸价格并不自动意味着计划的支出降低，也不自动意味着患者的成本降低。

segments.src: Coverage design, cost sharing and how long people stay on treatment will determine the real financial effect.
segments.tr: 报销设计、费用分摊以及人们坚持治疗多长时间将决定实际的财务影响。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 接下来要注意什么

segments.src: - **New approvals and launches** of oral and next-generation GLP-1 products, and how they are priced.
segments.tr: - 口服和下一代GLP-1产品的**新批准和推出**，以及它们的定价方式。

segments.src: - **Medicare and Medicaid policy changes** that could broaden or narrow eligibility.
segments.tr: - 可能扩大或缩小资格的**Medicare和Medicaid政策变化**。

segments.src: - **Employer plan decisions** during open enrollment season.
segments.tr: - 公开注册期间的**雇主计划决策**。

segments.src: - **Long-term outcome data** on whether lower prices translate into healthier populations and savings elsewhere in the system.
segments.tr: - 关于更低价格是否能转化为更健康的群系统内其他地方节省的**长期结果数据**。

segments.src: - **Safety and quality oversight** of compounded and online-sold products.
segments.tr: - 对复方和在线销售产品的**安全和质量监管**。

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: GLP-1 drugs are becoming more affordable than they were, but affordability is still uneven.
segments.tr: GLP-1药物正变得比以前更具可负担性，但可负担性仍然不均衡。

segments.src: For patients, the best steps are to check coverage, compare cash prices at the dose they will actually use, and work with a licensed clinician.
segments.tr: 对于患者而言，最好的步骤是检查报销情况，在他们实际使用的剂量下比较现金价格，并与持牌临床医生合作。

segments.src: For employers and insurers, the challenge is to balance access with sustainable costs.
segments.tr: 对于雇主和保险公司而言，挑战在于平衡获取途径与可持续的成本。

segments.src: For policymakers, the question is how to widen access without straining public budgets.
segments.tr: 对于决策者而言，问题在于如何在不使公共预算紧张的情况下扩大获取途径。

segments.src: The coming year of coverage decisions will likely determine whether falling prices reach the people who could benefit most.
segments.tr: 未来一年的报销决策可能会决定下降的价格是否能触及那些最能受益的人。

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not medical, legal or financial advice.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息参考，并非医疗、法律或财务建议。

segments.src: Consult a qualified professional about your own situation.*
segments.tr: 请就您自己的情况咨询合格的专业人士。*

segments.tr: कई ताकतें एक ही समय में लागत को नीचे धकेल रही हैं:

segments.src: - **Lower list and cash prices.** Manufacturers have introduced reduced self-pay prices and negotiated pricing arrangements, especially for lower starting doses.
segments.tr: - **कम सूची और नकद कीमतें।** निर्माताओं ने कम शुरुआती खुराक के लिए विशेष रूप से कम स्व-भुगतान कीमतें और बातचीत की गई मूल्य निर्धारण व्यवस्था पेश की है।

segments.src: - **Direct-to-consumer channels.** Drugmakers now sell directly to patients through their own online platforms and telehealth partners, bypassing some of the usual pharmacy and middleman layers. Cash prices are often lower than the old list price, though they still vary by dose.
segments.tr: - **डायरेक्ट-टू-कसुमर चैनल।** दवा निर्माता अब अपने स्वयं के ऑनलाइन प्लेटफार्मों और टेलीहेल्थ भागीदारों के माध्यम से सीधे मरीजों को बेचते हैं, सामान्य फार्मेसी और बिचौलियों की परतों में से कुछ को दरकिनार करते हैं। नकद कीमतें अक्सर पुरानी सूची मूल्य से कम होती हैं, हालांकि वे अभी भी खुराक के अनुसार भिन्न होती हैं।

segments.src: - **Pill formulations.** Oral GLP-1 products avoid the cost and complexity of injectable pens, and they may be easier to manufacture and distribute at scale. More oral candidates are in the pipeline.
segments.tr: - **गोली के रूप।** मौखिक GLP-1 उत्पाद इंजेक्शन पेन की लागत और जटिलता से बचते हैं, और उन्हें बड़े पैमाने पर निर्माण और वितरित करना आसान हो सकता है। अधिक मौखिक उम्मीदवार पाइपलाइन में हैं।

segments.src: - **Competition.** With multiple companies selling similar drugs, and more expected, pricing pressure is increasing. Supply shortages that once limited access have also eased.
segments.tr: - **प्रतिस्पर्धा।** कई कंपनियों द्वारा समान दवाओं को बेचने और अधिक की उम्मीद के साथ, मूल्य निर्धारण का दबाव बढ़ रहा है। आपूर्ति की कमी जिसने कभी पहुँच को सीमित कर दिया था, वह भी कम हो गई है।

segments.src: - **Government negotiation and policy.** Federal pricing agreements and Medicare negotiation efforts have put GLP-1 costs in the political spotlight.
segments.tr: - **सरकारी बातचीत और नीति।** संघीय मूल्य निर्धारण समझौतों और मेडिकर बातचीत के प्रयासों ने GLP-1 लागतों को राजनीतिक सुर्खियों में ला दिया है।

segments.src: ## What it means for patients
segments.tr: ## रोगियों के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: For people paying out of pocket, lower cash prices can turn a drug that was out of reach into one that is difficult but possible.
segments.tr: अपनी जेब से भुगतान करने वाले लोगों के लिए, कम नकद कीमतें एक ऐसी दवा को बदल सकती हैं जो पहुँच से बाहर थी, एक ऐसी दवा में जो कठिन है लेकिन संभव है।

segments.src: A few practical points apply:
segments.tr: कुछ व्यावहारिक बिंदु लागू होते हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Compare the full cost.** Look at the monthly price at your actual dose, not only an introductory rate. Maintenance doses may cost more than starter doses.
segments.tr: 1. **कुल लागत की तुलना करें।** अपनी वास्तविक खुराक पर मासिक कीमत देखें, न कि केवल एक परिचयात्मक दर। रखरखाव की खुराक शुरूआती खुराक से अधिक खर्च कर सकती है।

segments.src: 2. **Ask about coverage first.** Insurance may still be cheaper than cash, and some plans cover the drugs for diabetes but not for weight loss alone.
segments.tr: 2. **पहले कवरेज के बारे में पूछें।** बीमा अभी भी नकद से सस्ता हो सकता है, और कुछ योजनाएं मधुमेह के लिए दवाओं को कवर करती हैं लेकिन अकेले वजन घटाने के लिए नहीं।

segments.src: 3. **Treat it as long-term.** Clinical evidence suggests that many people regain weight after stopping these medicines. A price that works for three months may not work for three years.
segments.tr: 3. **इसे दीर्घकालिक रूप में मानें।** नैदानिक साक्ष्य बताते हैं कि कई लोग इन दवाओं को रोकने के बाद वजन वापस पा लेते हैं। एक कीमत जो तीन महीने के लिए काम करती है वह तीन साल के लिए काम नहीं कर सकती है।

segments.src: 4. **Stay with licensed care.** Buy only from licensed pharmacies and manufacturers' authorized channels. Be wary of unregulated "research" products or suspiciously cheap online offers, and speak with a clinician about side effects, suitability and monitoring.
segments.tr: 4. **लाइसेंस प्राप्त देखभाल के साथ रहें।** केवल लाइसेंस प्राप्त फार्मेसी और निर्माताओं के अधिकृत चैनलों से खरीदें। अनिर्दिष्ट "अनुसंधान" उत्पादों या संदिग्ध रूप से सस्ते ऑनलाइन प्रस्तावों से सावधान रहें, और दुष्प्रभावों, उपयुक्तता और निगरानी के बारे में किसी चिकित्सक से बात करें।

segments.src: 5. **Don't skip the basics.** The drugs are generally prescribed alongside nutrition and activity changes, and results differ from person to person.
segments.tr: 5. **बुनियादी बातों को न छोड़ें।** दवाएं आम तौर पर पोषण और गतिविधि में बदलाव के साथ निर्धारित की जाती हैं, और परिणाम एक व्यक्ति से दूसरे व्यक्ति में भिन्न होते हैं।

segments.src: ## What it means for employers
segments.tr: ## नियोक्ताओं के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: Employers that fund their own health plans have been among the most cautious payers.
segments.tr: अपने स्वयं के स्वास्थ्य योजनाओं को वित्त पोषित करने वाले नियोक्ता सबसे सतर्क भुगतानकर्ताओं में से रहे हैं।

segments.src: Their concern is not just the price per prescription but the number of employees who could qualify.
segments.tr: उनकी चिंता केवल प्रति नुस्खा कीमत नहीं है बल्कि उन कर्मचारियों की संख्या है जो योग्य हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: If a large share of eligible workers started treatment at a high price, the cost could overwhelm a benefits budget.
segments.tr: यदि योग्य श्रमिकों का एक बड़ा हिस्सा उच्च कीमत पर उपचार शुरू करता है, तो लागत लाभ बजट को अभिभूत कर सकती है।

segments.src: Lower prices change that math, but they do not remove the tension.
segments.tr: कम कीमतें उस गणित को बदल देती हैं, लेकिन वे तनाव को दूर नहीं करती हैं।

segments.src: Employers are weighing:
segments.tr: नियोक्ता वजन कर रहे हैं:

segments.src: - **Coverage limits.** Some require prior authorization, a documented body mass index threshold, or participation in a lifestyle program.
segments.tr: - **क कवरेज सीमाएँ।** कुछ लोगों को पूर्व प्राधिकरण, एक प्रलेखित बॉडी मास इंडेक्स सीमा, या जीवन शैली कार्यक्रम में भागीदारी की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing design.** Higher copays can limit spending but may discourage people who would benefit most.
segments.tr: - **लागत-साझाकरण डिजाइन।** उच्च सह-भुगतान खर्च को सीमित कर सकते हैं लेकिन उन लोगों को हतोत्साहित कर सकते हैं जिन्हें सबसे अधिक लाभ होगा।

segments.src: - **Possible offsetting savings.** Better control of weight, diabetes and heart-related risks could reduce other medical spending over time, but the timing and size of those savings remain debated. Many employees change jobs before long-term savings show up for a given employer.
segments.tr: - **संभावित ऑफसेट बचत।** वजन, मधुमेह और हृदय से संबंधित जोखिमों का बेहतर नियंत्रण समय के साथ अन्य चिकित्सा खर्च को कम कर सकता है, लेकिन उन बचतों का समय और आकार बहस का विषय बना हुआ है। कई कर्मचारी किसी दिए गए नियोक्ता के लिए दीर्घकालिक बचत दिखाने से पहले नौकरियां बदलते हैं।

segments.src: - **Alternatives to traditional coverage.** Some employers are exploring negotiated direct purchasing arrangements or navigation services rather than adding the drugs to standard drug benefits.
segments.tr: - **पारंपरिक कवरेज के विकल्प।** कुछ नियोक्ता मानक दवा लाभों में दवाओं को जोड़ने के बजाय बातचीत की गई प्रत्यक्ष खरीद व्यवस्था या नेविगेशन सेवाओं की खोज कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: ## What it means for Medicare and Medicaid
segments.tr: ## मेडिकर और मेडिसीड के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: Public programs have historically been limited by law and by cost.
segments.tr: सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रम ऐतिहासिक रूप से कानून और लागत से सीमित रहे हैं।

segments.src: Medicare Part D has generally covered these drugs for conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular risk reduction in certain patients, and some other approved uses, but has not broadly covered medications used only for weight loss.
segments.tr: मेडिकर पार्ट डी ने आम तौर पर मधुमेह जैसी स्थितियों, कुछ रोगियों में हृदय जोखिम में कमी, और कुछ अन्य अनुमोदित उपयोगों के लिए इन दवाओं को कवर किया है, लेकिन व्यापक रूप से केवल वजन घटाने के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली दवाओं को कवर नहीं किया है।

segments.src: Federal and state officials have been exploring pilots, price agreements and rule changes that could expand access for some beneficiaries, and state Medicaid programs have taken differing approaches, with some adding coverage and others pulling back because of budget pressure.
segments.tr: संघीय और राज्य के अधिकारी पायलटों, मूल्य समझौतों और नियम परिवर्तनों की खोज कर रहे हैं जो कुछ लाभार्थियों के लिए पहुँच का विस्तार कर सकते हैं, और राज्य मेडिसीड कार्यक्रमों ने अलग-अलग दृष्टिकोण अपनाए हैं, कुछ कवरेज जोड़ रहे हैं और अन्य बजट दबाव के कारण पीछे हट रहे हैं।

segments.src: The key question is scale.
segments.tr: मुख्य प्रश्न पैमाना है।

segments.src: Millions of Medicare beneficiaries have obesity, so even a moderate net price per person can add up to a very large program cost.
segments.tr: लाखों मेडिकर लाभार्थियों को मोटापा है, इसलिए प्रति व्यक्ति मध्यम शुद्ध मूल्य भी बहुत बड़ी कार्यक्रम लागत तक जोड़ सकता है।

segments.src: Policymakers are balancing potential health benefits against the effect on federal spending and Part D premiums.
segments.tr: नीति निर्माता संघीय खर्च और पार्ट डी प्रीमियम पर प्रभाव के खिलाफ संभावित स्वास्थ्य लाभों को संतुलित कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Details of any expansion, including eligibility criteria, copays and start dates, should be confirmed through official Medicare and state sources.
segments.tr: पात्रता मानदंडों, सह-भुगतान और शुरू की तारीखों सहित किसी भी विस्तार के विवरण की पुष्टि आधिकारिक मेडिकर और राज्य स्रोतों के माध्यम से की जानी चाहिए。

segments.src: ## What it means for insurers
segments.tr: ## बीमाकर्ताओं के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: Insurers face a difficult trade-off.
segments.tr: बीमाकर्ताओं को एक कठिन व्यापार-बंद का सामना करना पड़ता है।

segments.src: Covering these drugs broadly can improve health outcomes for members, but it can raise premiums in the short run.
segments.tr: इन दवाओं को व्यापक रूप से कवर करने से सदस्यों के लिए स्वास्थ्य परिणाम में सुधार हो सकता है, लेकिन यह कम समय में प्रीमियम बढ़ा सकता है।

segments.src: Lower net prices make coverage easier to justify, yet insurers still manage costs through:
segments.tr: कम शुद्ध कीमतें कवरेज को सही ठहराना आसान बनाती हैं, फिर भी बीमाकर्ता लागत का प्रबंधन करते हैं:

segments.src: - Prior authorization and step requirements
segments.tr: - पूर्व प्राधिकरण और कदम आवश्यकताएं

segments.src: - Quantity limits and renewal criteria that require evidence of benefit
segments.tr: - मात्रा सीमा और नवीनीकरण मानदंड जिनके लिए लाभ के प्रमाण की आवश्यकता होती है

segments.src: - Preferred-drug lists that favor a particular product after negotiated rebates
segments.tr: - पसंदीदा-दवा सूचियां जो बातचीत किए गए छूट के बाद एक विशेष उत्पाद का पक्ष लेती हैं

segments.src: - Programs that pair medication with coaching or clinical monitoring
segments.tr: - ऐसे कार्यक्रम जो दवा को कोचिंग या नैदानिक निगरानी के साथ जोड़ते हैं

segments.src: How these tools are used will shape real-world access.
segments.tr: इन उपकरणों का उपयोग कैसे किया जाता है, यह वास्तविक दुनिया की पहुँच को आकार देगा।

segments.src: Two people with the same prescription can face very different out-of-pocket costs depending on their plan.
segments.tr: एक ही नुस्खे वाले दो लोग अपनी योजना के आधार पर बहुत अलग जेब खर्च का सामना कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## The bigger picture for the health system
segments.tr: ## स्वास्थ्य प्रणाली के लिए बड़ी तस्वीर

segments.src: If prices keep falling and more people start treatment, the effects could extend well beyond pharmacy budgets.
segments.tr: यदि कीमतें गिरती रहती हैं और अधिक लोग उपचार शुरू करते हैं, तो प्रभाव फार्मेसी बजट से परे अच्छी तरह से विस्तारित हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: Possible outcomes include lower rates of diabetes progression, fewer cardiovascular events and reduced joint and sleep-related problems.
segments.tr: संभावित परिणामों में मधुमेह की प्रगति की कम दर, कम हृदय संबंधी घटनाएं और कम जोड़ों और नींद से संबंधित समस्याएं शामिल हैं।

segments.src: At the same time, the health system could face higher drug spending, demand for clinicians who can manage long-term therapy, and questions about equity if only some groups can obtain coverage.
segments.tr: साथ ही, स्वास्थ्य प्रणाली उच्च दवा खर्च, ऐसे चिकित्सकों की मांग का सामना कर सकती है जो दीर्घकालिक चिकित्सा का प्रबंधन कर सकते हैं, और समानता के बारे में प्रश्न उठा सकते हैं यदि केवल कुछ समूह कवरेज प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Economists and health plans broadly agree on one point: the net price, after rebates and discounts, matters more than the list price.
segments.tr: अर्थशास्त्री और स्वास्थ्य योजनाएं एक बिंदु पर व्यापक रूप से सहमत हैं: छूट और छूट के बाद शुद्ध कीमत, सूची मूल्य से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण है।

segments.src: A lower sticker price does not automatically mean lower spending for a plan, and it does not automatically mean lower costs for a patient.
segments.tr: एक कम स्टिकर मूल्य का मतलब स्वचालित रूप से किसी योजना के लिए कम खर्च नहीं है, और इसका मतलब स्वचालित रूप से किसी रोगी के लिए कम लागत नहीं है।

segments.src: Coverage design, cost sharing and how long people stay on treatment will determine the real financial effect.
segments.tr: क कवरेज डिजाइन, लागत साझाकरण और लोग कितने समय तक उपचार पर रहते हैं, यह वास्तविक वित्तीय प्रभाव निर्धारित करेगा。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या देखना है

segments.src: - **New approvals and launches** of oral and next-generation GLP-1 products, and how they are priced.
segments.tr: - **नए अनुमोदन और लॉन्च** मौखिक और अगली पीढ़ी के GLP-1 उत्पादों के, और उनकी कीमत कैसे तय की जाती है।

segments.src: - **Medicare and Medicaid policy changes** that could broaden or narrow eligibility.
segments.tr: - **मेडिकर और मेडिसीड नीति परिवर्तन** जो पात्रता को विस्तृत या संकीर्ण कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Employer plan decisions** during open enrollment season.
segments.tr: - **नियोक्ता योजना निर्णय** खुले नामांकन सीजन के दौरान।

segments.src: - **Long-term outcome data** on whether lower prices translate into healthier populations and savings elsewhere in the system.

es.title: Los medicamentos para la pérdida de peso se vuelven más baratos: lo que la caída de los precios de los GLP-1 significa para los pacientes, empleadores y aseguradoras

segments.src: For several years, GLP-1 medicines such as semaglutide and tirzepatide have been among the most talked-about and hardest-to-afford drugs in American health care.
segments.tr: Durante varios años, los medicamentos GLP-1 como la semaglutida y la tirzepatida han estado entre los medicamentos de los que más se habla y que son más difíciles de pagar en la atención médica estadounidense.

segments.src: List prices of roughly $1,000 or more per month put them out of reach for many people, and coverage rules often made access harder still.
segments.tr: Los precios de lista de aproximadamente $1,000 o más por mes los dejaban fuera del alcance de muchas personas, y las reglas de cobertura a menudo hacían que el acceso fuera aún más difícil.

segments.src: That picture is now shifting.
segments.tr: Ese panorama está cambiando ahora.

segments.src: Lower prices, new oral options and direct-to-consumer sales are widening the pool of people who can realistically afford treatment, and they are forcing employers, Medicare and private insurers to rethink what they cover.
segments.tr: Los precios más bajos, las nuevas opciones orales y las ventas directas al consumidor están ampliando el grupo de personas que pueden pagar de manera realista el tratamiento, y están obligando a los empleadores, a Medicare y a las aseguradoras privadas a replantearse lo que cubren.

segments.src: This article explains what is changing, who stands to benefit, and why coverage decisions may matter more than any headline price.
segments.tr: Este artículo explica qué está cambiando, quiénes se benefician y por qué las decisiones de cobertura pueden importar más que cualquier precio de lista.

segments.src: It is general information, not medical or financial advice.
segments.tr: Es información general, no asesoramiento médico ni financiero.

segments.src: Prices, programs and eligibility rules change often, so check current details with your insurer, pharmacist or prescriber.
segments.tr: Los precios, los programas y las reglas de elegibilidad cambian con frecuencia, así que verifique los detalles actuales con su aseguradora, farmacéutico o prescritor.

segments.src: ## Why prices are moving
segments.tr: ## Why prices are moving

segments.src: Several forces are pushing costs down at the same time:
segments.tr: Varias fuerzas están haciendo bajar los costos al mismo tiempo:

segments.src: - **Lower list and cash prices.** Manufacturers have introduced reduced self-pay prices and negotiated pricing arrangements, especially for lower starting doses.
segments.tr: - **Lower list and cash prices.** Los fabricantes han introducido precios reducidos de pago por cuenta propia y acuerdos de precios negociados, especialmente para las dosis iniciales más bajas.

segments.src: - **Direct-to-consumer channels.** Drugmakers now sell directly to patients through their own online platforms and telehealth partners, bypassing some of the usual pharmacy and middleman layers. Cash prices are often lower than the old list price, though they still vary by dose.
segments.tr: - **Direct-to-consumer channels.** Los fabricantes de medicamentos ahora venden directamente a los pacientes a través de sus propias plataformas en línea y socios de telesalud, evitando algunas de las capas habituales de farmacias e intermediarios. Los precios en efectivo suelen ser más bajos que el antiguo precio de lista, aunque todavía varían según la dosis.

segments.src: - **Pill formulations.** Oral GLP-1 products avoid the cost and complexity of injectable pens, and they may be easier to manufacture and distribute at scale. More oral candidates are in the pipeline.
segments.tr: - **Pill formulations.** Los productos GLP-1 orales evitan el costo y la complejidad de las plumas inyectables, y pueden ser más fáciles de fabricar y distribuir a escala. Hay más candidatos orales en desarrollo.

segments.src: - **Competition.** With multiple companies selling similar drugs, and more expected, pricing pressure is increasing. Supply shortages that once limited access have also eased.
segments.tr: - **Competition.** Con múltiples empresas vendiendo medicamentos similares, y se esperan más, la presión sobre los precios está aumentando. La escasez de suministro que alguna vez limitó el acceso también se ha aliviado.

segments.src: - **Government negotiation and policy.** Federal pricing agreements and Medicare negotiation efforts have put GLP-1 costs in the political spotlight.
segments.tr: - **Government negotiation and policy.** Los acuerdos federales de precios y los esfuerzos de negociación de Medicare han puesto los costos de los GLP-1 en el centro de atención política.

segments.src: ## What it means for patients
segments.tr: ## What it means for patients

segments.src: For people paying out of pocket, lower cash prices can turn a drug that was out of reach into one that is difficult but possible.
segments.tr: Para las personas que pagan de su bolsillo, los precios en efectivo más bajos pueden convertir un medicamento que estaba fuera de alcance en uno que es difícil pero posible.

segments.src: A few practical points apply:
segments.tr: Se aplican algunos puntos prácticos:

segments.src: 1. **Compare the full cost.** Look at the monthly price at your actual dose, not only an introductory rate. Maintenance doses may cost more than starter doses.
segments.tr: 1. **Compare the full cost.** Mire el precio mensual a su dosis real, no solo una tarifa introductoria. Las dosis de mantenimiento pueden costar más que las dosis iniciales.

segments.src: 2. **Ask about coverage first.** Insurance may still be cheaper than cash, and some plans cover the drugs for diabetes but not for weight loss alone.
segments.tr: 2. **Ask about coverage first.** El seguro aún puede ser más barato que el pago en efectivo, y algunos planes cubren los medicamentos para la diabetes pero no solo para la pérdida de peso.

segments.src: 3. **Treat it as long-term.** Clinical evidence suggests that many people regain weight after stopping these medicines. A price that works for three months may not work for three years.
segments.tr: 3. **Treat it as long-term.** La evidencia clínica sugiere que muchas personas recuperan peso después de suspender estos medicamentos. Un precio que funciona durante tres meses puede no funcionar durante tres años.

segments.src: 4. **Stay with licensed care.** Buy only from licensed pharmacies and manufacturers' authorized channels. Be wary of unregulated "research" products or suspiciously cheap online offers, and speak with a clinician about side effects, suitability and monitoring.
segments.tr: 4. **Stay with licensed care.** Compre únicamente en farmacias autorizadas y canales autorizados por los fabricantes. Desconfíe de los productos de "investigación" no regulados o ofertas en línea sospechosamente baratas, y hable con un médico sobre los efectos secundarios, la idoneidad y el seguimiento.

segments.src: 5. **Don't skip the basics.** The drugs are generally prescribed alongside nutrition and activity changes, and results differ from person to person.
segments.tr: 5. **Don't skip the basics.** Los medicamentos generalmente se recetan junto con cambios en la nutrición y la actividad, y los resultados difieren de una persona a otra.

segments.src: ## What it means for employers
segments.tr: ## What it means for employers

segments.src: Employers that fund their own health plans have been among the most cautious payers.
segments.tr: Los empleadores que financian sus propios planes de salud han estado entre los pagadores más cautelosos.

segments.src: Their concern is not just the price per prescription but the number of employees who could qualify.
segments.tr: Su preocupación no es solo el precio por receta sino la cantidad de empleados que podrían calificar.

segments.src: If a large share of eligible workers started treatment at a high price, the cost could overwhelm a benefits budget.
segments.tr: Si una gran proporción de trabajadores elegibles comenzara el tratamiento a un precio alto, el costo podría abrumar un presupuesto de beneficios.

segments.src: Lower prices change that math, but they do not remove the tension.
segments.tr: Los precios más bajos cambian esa matemática, pero no eliminan la tensión.

segments.src: Employers are weighing:
segments.tr: Los empleadores están sopesando:

segments.src: - **Coverage limits.** Some require prior authorization, a documented body mass index threshold, or participation in a lifestyle program.
segments.tr: - **Coverage limits.** Algunos requieren autorización previa, un umbral de índice de masa corporal documentado o participación en un programa de estilo de vida.

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing design.** Higher copays can limit spending but may discourage people who would benefit most.
segments.tr: - **Cost-sharing design.** Los copagos más altos pueden limitar el gasto, pero pueden desalentar a las personas que más se beneficiarían.

segments.src: - **Possible offsetting savings.** Better control of weight, diabetes and heart-related risks could reduce other medical spending over time, but the timing and size of those savings remain debated. Many employees change jobs before long-term savings show up for a given employer.
segments.tr: - **Possible offsetting savings.** Un mejor control del peso, la diabetes y los riesgos relacionados con el corazón podría reducir otros gastos médicos con el tiempo, pero el momento y la magnitud de esos ahorros siguen siendo debatidos. Muchos empleados cambian de trabajo antes de que los ahorros a largo plazo se manifiesten para un empleador determinado.

segments.src: - **Alternatives to traditional coverage.** Some employers are exploring negotiated direct purchasing arrangements or navigation services rather than adding the drugs to standard drug benefits.
segments.tr: - **Alternatives to traditional coverage.** Algunos empleadores están explorando acuerdos de compra directa negociados o servicios de navegación en lugar de agregar los medicamentos a los beneficios farmacéuticos estándar.

segments.src: ## What it means for Medicare and Medicaid
segments.tr: ## What it means for Medicare and Medicaid

segments.src: Public programs have historically been limited by law and by cost.
segments.tr: Los programas públicos han estado históricamente limitados por la ley y por el costo.

segments.src: Medicare Part D has generally covered these drugs for conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular risk reduction in certain patients, and some other approved uses, but has not broadly covered medications used only for weight loss.
segments.tr: Medicare Parte D generalmente ha cubierto estos medicamentos para afecciones como la diabetes, la reducción del riesgo cardiovascular en ciertos pacientes y otros usos aprobados, pero no ha cubierto ampliamente los medicamentos utilizados únicamente para la pérdida de peso.

segments.src: Federal and state officials have been exploring pilots, price agreements and rule changes that could expand access for some beneficiaries, and state Medicaid programs have taken differing approaches, with some adding coverage and others pulling back because of budget pressure.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios federales y estatales han estado explorando programas piloto, acuerdos de precios y cambios de reglas que podrían ampliar el acceso para algunos beneficiarios, y los programas de Medicaid estatales han adoptado enfoques diferentes, y algunos agregan cobertura y otros retroceden debido a la presión presupuestaria.

segments.src: The key question is scale.
segments.tr: La pregunta clave es la escala.

segments.src: Millions of Medicare beneficiaries have obesity, so even a moderate net price per person can add up to a very large program cost.
segments.tr: Millones de beneficiarios de Medicare tienen obesidad, por lo que incluso un precio neto moderado por persona puede sumar un costo de programa muy grande.

segments.src: Policymakers are balancing potential health benefits against the effect on federal spending and Part D premiums.
segments.tr: Los legisladores están equilibrando los posibles beneficios para la salud frente al efecto sobre el gasto federal y las primas de la Parte D.

segments.src: Details of any expansion, including eligibility criteria, copays and start dates, should be confirmed through official Medicare and state sources.
segments.tr: Los detalles de cualquier expansión, incluidos los criterios de elegibilidad, los copagos y las fechas de inicio, deben confirmarse a través de fuentes oficiales de Medicare y estatales.

segments.src: ## What it means for insurers
segments.tr: ## What it means for insurers

segments.src: Insurers face a difficult trade-off.
segments.tr: Las aseguradoras se enfrentan a un equilibrio difícil.

segments.src: Covering these drugs broadly can improve health outcomes for members, but it can raise premiums in the short run.
segments.tr: Cubrir estos medicamentos ampliamente puede mejorar los resultados de salud para los miembros, pero puede aumentar las primas a corto plazo.

segments.src: Lower net prices make coverage easier to justify, yet insurers still manage costs through:
segments.tr: Los precios netos más bajos hacen que la cobertura sea más fácil de justificar, sin embargo, las aseguradoras aún gestionan los costos a través de:

segments.src: - Prior authorization and step requirements
segments.tr: - Autorización previa y requisitos escalonados

segments.src: - Quantity limits and renewal criteria that require evidence of benefit
segments.tr: - Límites de cantidad y criterios de renovación que requieren evidencia de beneficio

segments.src: - Preferred-drug lists that favor a particular product after negotiated rebates
segments.tr: - Listas de medicamentos preferidos que favorecen un producto en particular después de reembolsos negociados

segments.src: - Programs that pair medication with coaching or clinical monitoring
segments.tr: - Programas que combinan la medicación con asesoramiento o seguimiento clínico

segments.src: How these tools are used will shape real-world access.
segments.tr: Cómo se utilicen estas herramientas dará forma al acceso en el mundo real.

segments.src: Two people with the same prescription can face very different out-of-pocket costs depending on their plan.
segments.tr: Dos personas con la misma receta pueden enfrentar costos de su bolsillo muy diferentes según su plan.

segments.src: ## The bigger picture for the health system
segments.tr: ## The bigger picture for the health system

segments.src: If prices keep falling and more people start treatment, the effects could extend well beyond pharmacy budgets.
segments.tr: Si los precios siguen cayendo y más personas comienzan el tratamiento, los efectos podrían extenderse mucho más allá de los presupuestos de farmacia.

segments.src: Possible outcomes include lower rates of diabetes progression, fewer cardiovascular events and reduced joint and sleep-related problems.
segments.tr: Los posibles resultados incluyen tasas más bajas de progresión de la diabetes, menos eventos cardiovasculares y problemas reducidos en las articulaciones y relacionados con el sueño.

segments.src: At the same time, the health system could face higher drug spending, demand for clinicians who can manage long-term therapy, and questions about equity if only some groups can obtain coverage.
segments.tr: Al mismo tiempo, el sistema de salud podría enfrentar un mayor gasto en medicamentos, demanda de médicos que puedan manejar la terapia a largo plazo y preguntas sobre la equidad si solo algunos grupos pueden obtener cobertura.

segments.src: Economists and health plans broadly agree on one point: the net price, after rebates and discounts, matters more than the list price.
segments.tr: Los economistas y los planes de salud coinciden ampliamente en un punto: el precio neto, después de reembolsos y descuentos, importa más que el precio de lista.

segments.src: A lower sticker price does not automatically mean lower spending for a plan, and it does not automatically mean lower costs for a patient.
segments.tr: Un precio de etiqueta más bajo no significa automáticamente un menor gasto para un plan, y no significa automáticamente costos más bajos para un paciente.

segments.src: Coverage design, cost sharing and how long people stay on treatment will determine the real financial effect.
segments.tr: El diseño de la cobertura, el costo compartido y el tiempo que las personas permanezcan en tratamiento determinarán el efecto financiero real.

segments.tr: - **Safety and quality oversight** de productos compuestos y vendidos en línea.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Bottom line

segments.tr: Los medicamentos GLP-1 se están volviendo más accesibles que antes, pero la asequibilidad sigue siendo desigual.

segments.src: - **Competition.** With multiple companies selling similar drugs, and more expected, pricing pressure is increasing. Supply shortages that once limited access have also eased.
segments.tr: - **المنافسة.** مع وجود شركات متعددة تبيع أدوية متشابهة، ويتوقع المزيد منها، يزداد الضغط على الأسعار. كما انحسرت نقص الإمدادات التي كانت تحد من الوصول سابقاً.

segments.src: - **Government negotiation and policy.** Federal pricing agreements and Medicare negotiation efforts have put GLP-1 costs in the political spotlight.
segments.tr: - **المفاوضات الحكومية والسياسات.** وضعت اتفاقيات التسعير الفيدرالية وجهود المفاوضات لبرنامج Medicare تكاليف GLP-1 في بؤرة الضوء السياسي.

segments.src: ## What it means for patients
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا للمرضى

segments.src: For people paying out of pocket, lower cash prices can turn a drug that was out of reach into one that is difficult but possible.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للأشخاص الذين يدفعون من جيوبهم، يمكن للأسعار النقدية المنخفضة أن تحول الدواء الذي كان بعيد المنال إلى دواء صعب ولكنه ممكن.

segments.src: A few practical points apply:
segments.tr: تنطبق بضع نقاط عملية:

segments.src: 1. **Compare the full cost.** Look at the monthly price at your actual dose, not only an introductory rate. Maintenance doses may cost more than starter doses.
segments.tr: 1. **قارن التكلفة الكاملة.** انظر إلى السعر الشهري للجرعة الفعلية الخاصة بك، وليس فقط السعر التمهيدي. قد تكلف جرعات الاستمرار أكثر من الجرعات البدائية.

segments.src: 2. **Ask about coverage first.** Insurance may still be cheaper than cash, and some plans cover the drugs for diabetes but not for weight loss alone.
segments.tr: 2. **اسأل عن التغطية أولاً.** قد يظل التأمين أرخص من الدفع النقدي، وتغطي بعض الخطط الأدوية لمرض السكري ولكن ليس لإنقاص الوزن بمفرده.

segments.src: 3. **Treat it as long-term.** Clinical evidence suggests that many people regain weight after stopping these medicines. A price that works for three months may not work for three years.
segments.tr: 3. **تعامل معه كعلاج طويل الأجل.** تشير الأدلة السريرية إلى أن العديد من الأشخاص يستعيدون أوزانهم بعد التوقف عن هذه الأدوية. السعر الذي يناسبك لمدة ثلاثة أشهر قد لا يناسبك لمدة ثلاث سنوات.

segments.src: 4. **Stay with licensed care.** Buy only from licensed pharmacies and manufacturers' authorized channels. Be wary of unregulated "research" products or suspiciously cheap online offers, and speak with a clinician about side effects, suitability and monitoring.
segments.tr: 4. **التزم بالرعاية المرخصة.** اشترِ فقط من الصيدليات المرخصة والقنوات المعتمدة للمصنعين. حذر من المنتجات "البحثية" غير المنظمة أو العروض الرخيصة بشكل مشبوه عبر الإنترنت، وتحدث مع طبيب حول الآثار الجانبية والملاءمة والمراقبة.

segments.src: 5. **Don't skip the basics.** The drugs are generally prescribed alongside nutrition and activity changes, and results differ from person to person.
segments.tr: 5. **لا تتجاهل الأساسيات.** تُوصف الأدوية عموماً جنباً إلى جنب مع تغييرات التغذية والنشاط، وتختلف النتائج من شخص لآخر.

segments.src: ## What it means for employers
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا لأصحاب العمل

segments.src: Employers that fund their own health plans have been among the most cautious payers.
segments.tr: كان أصحاب العمل الذين يمولون خططهم الصحية الخاصة من بين أكثر الجهات الدافتة حذراً.

segments.src: Their concern is not just the price per prescription but the number of employees who could qualify.
segments.tr: مصدر قلقهم ليس فقط السعر لكل وصفة طبية، بل عدد الموظفين الذين يمكن أن يكونوا مؤهلين.

segments.src: If a large share of eligible workers started treatment at a high price, the cost could overwhelm a benefits budget.
segments.tr: إذا بدأت نسبة كبيرة من العمال المؤهلين العلاج بسعر مرتفع، فقد تتجاوز التكلفة ميزانية المزايا.

segments.src: Lower prices change that math, but they do not remove the tension.
segments.tr: تغير الأسعار المنخفضة هذه المعادلة، لكنها لا تزيل التوتر.

segments.src: Employers are weighing:
segments.tr: يدرس أصحاب العمل ما يلي:

segments.src: - **Coverage limits.** Some require prior authorization, a documented body mass index threshold, or participation in a lifestyle program.
segments.tr: - **حدود التغطية.** يتطلب البعض إذنًا مسبقًا، أو حدًا أدنى موثقًا لمؤشر كتلة الجسم، أو المشاركة في برنامج نمط الحياة.

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing design.** Higher copays can limit spending but may discourage people who would benefit most.
segments.tr: - **تصميم مشاركة التكاليف.** يمكن للدفعات المشتركة الأعلى أن تحد من الإنفاق ولكنها قد تحبط الأشخاص الذين قد يستفيدون أكثر من غيرهم.

segments.src: - **Possible offsetting savings.** Better control of weight, diabetes and heart-related risks could reduce other medical spending over time, but the timing and size of those savings remain debated. Many employees change jobs before long-term savings show up for a given employer.
segments.tr: - **مدخرات تعويضية محتملة.** يمكن للتحكم الأفضل في الوزن والسكري والمخاطر المتعلقة بالقلب أن يقلل من الإنفاق الطبي الآخر بمرور الوقت، ولكن التوقيت وحجم هذه المدخرات يظلان محل نقاش. يغير العديد من الموظفين وظائفهم قبل أن تظهر المدخرات طويلة الأجل لرب عمل معين.

segments.src: - **Alternatives to traditional coverage.** Some employers are exploring negotiated direct purchasing arrangements or navigation services rather than adding the drugs to standard drug benefits.
segments.tr: - **بدائل التغطية التقليدية.** يستكشف بعض أصحاب العمل ترتيبات الشراء المباشر المتفاوض عليها أو خدمات التوجيه بدلاً من إضافة الأدوية إلى منافع الأدوية القياسية.

segments.src: ## What it means for Medicare and Medicaid
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا لبرنامجي Medicare و Medicaid

segments.src: Public programs have historically been limited by law and by cost.
segments.tr: كانت البرامج العامة مقيدة تاريخياً بموجب القانون والتكلفة.

segments.src: Medicare Part D has generally covered these drugs for conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular risk reduction in certain patients, and some other approved uses, but has not broadly covered medications used only for weight loss.
segments.tr: غطى الجزء D من Medicare بشكل عام هذه الأدوية لحالات مثل السكري، وتقليل مخاطر القلب والأوعية الدموية لدى مرضى معنيين، وبعض الاستخدامات المعتمدة الأخرى، ولكن لم يغطِ بشكل واسع الأدوية المستخدمة فقط لإنقاص الوزن.

segments.src: Federal and state officials have been exploring pilots, price agreements and rule changes that could expand access for some beneficiaries, and state Medicaid programs have taken differing approaches, with some adding coverage and others pulling back because of budget pressure.
segments.tr: استكشف المسؤولون الفيدراليون والولائيون مشاريع تجريبية، واتفاقيات أسعار، وتغييرات في القواعد التي يمكن أن توسع نطاق الوصول لبعض المستفيدين، كما اتخذت برامج Medicaid الخاصة بالولايات نهجاً مختلفة، حيث أضاف بعضها تغطية بينما تراجع البعض الآخر بسبب ضغوط الميزانية.

segments.src: The key question is scale.
segments.tr: السؤال الرئيسي هو النطاق.

segments.src: Millions of Medicare beneficiaries have obesity, so even a moderate net price per person can add up to a very large program cost.
segments.tr: يعاني الملايين من مستفيدي Medicare من السمنة، لذا فحتى السعر الصافي المعتدل للشخص الواحد يمكن أن يضيف تكلفة برنامج ضخمة للغاية.

segments.src: Policymakers are balancing potential health benefits against the effect on federal spending and Part D premiums.
segments.tr: يزن صانعو السياسات الفوائد الصحية المحتملة مقابل التأثير على الإنفاق الفيدرالي وأقساط الجزء D.

segments.src: Details of any expansion, including eligibility criteria, copays and start dates, should be confirmed through official Medicare and state sources.
segments.tr: يجب التأكد من تفاصيل أي توسع، بما في ذلك معايير الأهلية، والدفعات المشتركة، وتواريخ البدء، من خلال مصادر Medicare الرسمية ومصادر الولاية.

segments.src: ## What it means for insurers
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا لشركات التأمين

segments.src: Insurers face a difficult trade-off.
segments.tr: تواجه شركات التأمين مفاضلة صعبة.

segments.src: Covering these drugs broadly can improve health outcomes for members, but it can raise premiums in the short run.
segments.tr: يمكن لتغطية هذه الأدوية بشكل واسع أن تحسن النتائج الصحية للأعضاء، ولكنها يمكن أن ترفع الأقساط على المدى القريب.

segments.src: Lower net prices make coverage easier to justify, yet insurers still manage costs through:
segments.tr: تجعل الأسعار الصافية المنخفضة التغطية أسهل في التبرير، ومع ذلك تنظم شركات التأمين التكاليف من خلال:

segments.src: - Prior authorization and step requirements
segments.tr: - الإذن المسبق ومتطلبات العلاج التدرجي

segments.src: - Quantity limits and renewal criteria that require evidence of benefit
segments.tr: - حدود الكمية ومعايير التجديد التي تتطلب إثبات الفائدة

segments.src: - Preferred-drug lists that favor a particular product after negotiated rebates
segments.tr: - قوائم الأدوية المفضلة التي تفضل منتجًا معينًا بعد الخصومات المتفاوض عليها

segments.src: - Programs that pair medication with coaching or clinical monitoring
segments.tr: - البرامج التي تقرن الدواء بالتوجيه أو المراقبة السريرية

segments.src: How these tools are used will shape real-world access.
segments.tr: طريقة استخدام هذه الأدوات ستشكل وصولاً حقيقياً في العالم الواقعي.

segments.src: Two people with the same prescription can face very different out-of-pocket costs depending on their plan.
segments.tr: يمكن لشخصين يتناولان نفس الوصفة الطبية أن يواجها تكاليف مختلفة تماماً تدفع من الجيب اعتماداً على خطتهما.

segments.src: ## The bigger picture for the health system
segments.tr: ## الصورة الأكبر للنظام الصحي

segments.src: If prices keep falling and more people start treatment, the effects could extend well beyond pharmacy budgets.
segments.tr: إذا استمرت الأسعار في الانخفاض وبدأ المزيد من الأشخاص في العلاج، فقد تمتد الآثار إلى ما هو أبعد بكثير من ميزانيات الصيدليات.

segments.src: Possible outcomes include lower rates of diabetes progression, fewer cardiovascular events and reduced joint and sleep-related problems.
segments.tr: تشمل النتائج المحتملة انخفاض معدلات تطور مرض السكري، وانخفاض نوبات القلب والأوعية الدموية، وتقليل المشاكل المتعلقة بالمفاصل والنوم.

segments.src: At the same time, the health system could face higher drug spending, demand for clinicians who can manage long-term therapy, and questions about equity if only some groups can obtain coverage.
segments.tr: في الوقت نفسه، قد يواجه النظام الصحي إنفاقًا أعلى على الأدوية، وطلبًا على الأطباء الذين يمكنهم إدارة العلاج طويل الأجل، وأسئلة حول المساواة إذا تمكنت مجموعات معينة فقط من الحصول على التغطية.

segments.src: Economists and health plans broadly agree on one point: the net price, after rebates and discounts, matters more than the list price.
segments.tr: يتفق الاقتصادون والخطط الصحية عمومًا على نقطة واحدة: السعر الصافي، بعد الخصومات والتخفيضات، يهم أكثر من السعر المعلن.

segments.src: A lower sticker price does not automatically mean lower spending for a plan, and it does not automatically mean lower costs for a patient.
segments.tr: السعر المعلن المنخفض لا يعني تلقائياً إنفاقاً أقل لخطة ما، ولا يعني تلقائياً تكاليف أقل للمريض.

segments.src: Coverage design, cost sharing and how long people stay on treatment will determine the real financial effect.
segments.tr: تصميم التغطية، ومشاركة التكاليف، ومدة بقاء الأشخاص على العلاج هي التي ستحدد الأثر المالي الحقيقي.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## ما يجب متابعته لاحقاً

segments.tr: - **الموافقات والإطلاقات الجديدة** لمنتجات GLP-1 الفموية والجيل القادم، وكيفية تسعيرها.

segments.src: - **Medicare and Medicaid policy changes** that could broaden or narrow eligibility.
segments.tr: - **تغييرات سياسات Medicare و Medicaid** التي قد توسع الأهلية أو تضيقها.

segments.src: - **Employer plan decisions** during open enrollment season.
segments.tr: - **قرارات خطط أصحاب العمل** خلال موسم التسجيل المفتوح.

segments.src: - **Long-term outcome data** on whether lower prices translate into healthier populations and savings elsewhere in the system.
segments.tr: - **بيانات النتائج طويلة الأجل** حول ما إذا كانت الأسعار المنخفضة تترجم إلى مجتمعات أكثر صحة ومدخرات في أماكن أخرى من النظام.

segments.src: - **Safety and quality oversight** of compounded and online-sold products.
segments.tr: - **الرقابة على السلامة والجودة** للمنتجات المركبة والمباعة عبر الإنترنت.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: GLP-1 drugs are becoming more affordable than they were, but affordability is still uneven.
segments.tr: أصبحت أدوية GLP-1 أكثر قدرة على تحمل التكاليف مما كانت عليه، ولكن القدرة على تحمل التكاليف ما زالت غير متساوية.

segments.src: For patients, the best steps are to check coverage, compare cash prices at the dose they will actually use, and work with a licensed clinician.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للمرضى، أفضل الخطوات هي التحقق من التغطية، ومقارنة الأسعار النقدية بالجرعة التي سيستخدمونها بالفعل، والعمل مع طبيب مرخص.

segments.src: For employers and insurers, the challenge is to balance access with sustainable costs.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لأصحاب العمل وشركات التأمين، يتمثل التحدي في الموازنة بين الوصول والتكاليف المستدامة.

segments.src: For policymakers, the question is how to widen access without straining public budgets.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لصانعي السياسات، فإن السؤال هو كيفية توسيع نطاق الوصول دون إجهاد الميزانيات العامة.

segments.src: The coming year of coverage decisions will likely determine whether falling prices reach the people who could benefit most.
segments.tr: من المرجح أن يحدد العام القادم من قرارات التغطية ما إذا كانت الأسعار المنخفضة ستصل إلى الأشخاص الذين يمكنهم الاستفادة منها أكثر من غيرهم.
